verdict.rationale: Proa documents programmatic surfaces of its own: it can be called over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java, and proa_framework_core can be adapted to other HTTP servers or runtimes. A probe also found an OpenAPI document at proa.so/openapi.json, but nothing shows what that spec covers or whether it lets you drive the product. The evidence is thin on API reference depth, so only the core of the story is supported. Missing for 10: a documented API reference describing what the OpenAPI endpoints control, details on the FFI API's operations and stability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
